items.title: 亞馬遜市值站穩3兆美元躋身第5家 專家稱當前經濟縮影：完美融合消費與AI
items.title_en: Amazon’s Market Value Holds at $3 Trillion, Becomes Fifth Company; Experts Say It Mirrors the Current Economy: Perfect Fusion of Consumer Demand and AI
paras: 亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 市值周一 (3 日) 首度突破 3 兆美元，利多來自亮眼財報，以及人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮持續帶動旗下雲端事業需求增溫。這也代表亞馬遜成為蘋果 (AAPL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、輝達(NVDA-US) 及 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)之後，第五家市值突破 3 兆美元的企業。
亞馬遜股價股價周一終場上漲 4.6% 至每股 284.02 美元，盤中一度大漲 5% 至 285.01 美元，改寫歷史新高，今年來累計漲幅已超過 23%。
亞馬遜上周公布財報後，股價創 2012 年 4 月以來最大單日漲幅，主因旗下雲端事業 AWS(Amazon Web Services) 營收年增 37% ，創逾四年來最快增速，公司也同步上調全年資本支出預估。
市場原本擔心超大規模雲端服務商 (hyperscaler) 可能放緩 AI 投資，但亞馬遜與微軟最新財報均顯示，AI 基礎設施需求依舊強勁，帶動市場情緒明顯改善。
Nationwide 首席市場策略師 Hackett 表示：「亞馬遜可說是當前經濟的最佳縮影，它同時代表消費需求，也代表 AI 發展。」
他表示，市場在財報季前最大的疑慮，是超大規模雲端服務商是否開始縮減 AI 投資，但從亞馬遜與微軟財報來看，並未出現這種情況，也讓市場更放心 AI 投資趨勢仍將持續。
在亞馬遜帶動下，其他大型科技股周一同步走高，微軟上漲 4%，Meta Platforms(META-US)勁揚 6%，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)上漲 3.6%，甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 漲 5%。
微軟上周表示，預估至 2027 會計年度仍可維持正現金流，且資本支出將低於華爾街預期，帶動股價創 2008 年來最大單日漲幅。
不過，各家 AI 投資帶來的財務壓力開始出現差異。特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 與 Alphabet 上季自由現金流均轉為負值，其中 Alphabet 更是首次出現負現金流，Meta 自由現金流則暴跌 91%，反映企業持續投入數十億美元擴建 AI 基礎設施。
Hackett 說：「市場開始區分『科技七巨頭 (Magnificent Seven)』誰是真正的贏家、誰是輸家。過去很長一段時間，投資人幾乎把它們視為同一家公司，但從上周開始，市場開始依照各家公司基本面分別評價，這反而是健康現象。」
目前曾站上市值 3 兆美元的企業包括蘋果 (Apple，AAPL-US)、微軟、Alphabet、輝達(NVDA-US) 與亞馬遜。其中輝達目前仍是全球市值最高企業，市值接近 5 兆美元。
亞馬遜在 1994 年由貝佐斯 (Jeff Bezos) 創立，自 2024 年 6 月市值首度突破 2 兆美元後，僅花約兩年時間便再增加 1 兆美元市值。
AWS 近年也積極擴大合作版圖，已與 OpenAI、Anthropic 及 Meta 等 AI 業者簽署雲端運算與 AI 晶片供應合作協議，持續受惠 AI 運算需求快速成長。
不過，若亞馬遜希望維持市場高度期待，未來仍須持續交出亮眼的雲端業績，尤其是在 AI 投資持續消耗現金的情況下。亞馬遜已將 2026 年資本支出預估由 2000 億美元提高至 2200 億美元，而過去 12 個月自由現金流仍為負 76 億美元。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) saw its market value break the $3 trillion mark for the first time on Monday (the 3rd), driven by a stellar earnings report and the ongoing AI boom that continues to heat up demand for its cloud business. This makes Amazon the fifth company, after Apple (AAPL-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US), to surpass a $3 trillion market cap.
Amazon’s stock closed up 4.6% on Monday at $284.02 per share, after spiking as high as $285.01 during the session – a new all‑time high – and is up more than 23% so far this year.

After Amazon released its earnings last week, the stock posted its biggest single‑day gain since April 2012, mainly because its cloud unit AWS (Amazon Web Services) posted revenue that grew 37% year‑over‑year, the fastest pace in over four years, and the company also raised its full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook.

The market had been worried that hyperscale cloud providers might start to scale back AI investment, but the latest earnings from Amazon and Microsoft both show that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong, lifting market sentiment noticeably.
Nationwide chief market strategist Hackett said, “Amazon can be seen as the best micro‑cosm of the current economy – it represents both consumer demand and AI development.”

He added that the biggest pre‑earnings‑season concern was whether hyperscale cloud providers were beginning to cut back AI spending, but the results from Amazon and Microsoft showed no such pullback, reassuring investors that AI investment trends will continue.
Following Amazon’s rally, other large‑cap tech stocks rose on Monday as well: Microsoft gained 4%, Meta Platforms (META‑US) surged 6%, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) climbed 3.6% and Oracle (ORCL‑US) jumped 5%.

Microsoft said last week that it expects to maintain positive cash flow through its fiscal 2027 year and that its capital spending will be below Wall Street expectations, driving its stock to its biggest single‑day rise since 2008.

However, the financial pressure from AI spending is beginning to diverge across companies. Tesla (TSLA‑US) and Alphabet both posted negative free cash flow last quarter, with Alphabet recording a negative cash flow for the first time, while Meta’s free cash flow plunged 91%, reflecting billions of dollars poured into expanding AI infrastructure.

Hackett noted, “The market is now distinguishing which of the ‘Magnificent Seven’ are true winners and which are laggards. For a long time investors treated them as a single entity, but since last week the market is evaluating each company on its own fundamentals, which is a healthy development.”

The companies that have previously reached a $3 trillion market cap include Apple (AAPL‑US), Microsoft, Alphabet, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and now Amazon. Nvidia remains the world’s most valuable company, with a market cap close to $5 trillion.
Amazon was founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994. After first breaking the $2 trillion threshold in June 2024, it added another $1 trillion in market value in roughly two years.

AWS has been aggressively expanding its partnership ecosystem in recent years, signing cloud‑computing and AI‑chip supply agreements with AI players such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, and continues to benefit from rapidly growing AI compute demand.

Nevertheless, if Amazon wants to keep market expectations high, it will need to keep delivering strong cloud results, especially as AI investment continues to burn cash. Amazon has raised its 2026 capital‑expenditure estimate from $200 billion to $220 billion, and its free cash flow over the past 12 months remained a negative $7.6 billion.

items.title: 華許未能穩住Fed抗通膨信譽 摩根大通：年底前恐被迫升息
items.title_en: Warsh Fails to Uphold Fed's Anti-Inflation Credibility, JPMorgan Says Rate Hike Likely Before Year‑End
paras: 摩根大通銀行 (JPM-US) 美國經濟研究團隊指出，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）在上週利率決策後的記者會表現，堪稱自 2012 年開放此類溝通慣例以來最令人不安的一次，促使該行決定提前對升息時點的預測。
由費羅里（Michael Feroli）、漢森（Michael Hanson）與萊因哈特（Abiel Reinhart）組成的研究團隊表示，市場認為聯準會抗通膨公信力受到削弱，進一步提高貨幣政策轉向緊縮的迫切性，因此該團隊已將下一次升息時間從原先預估的 2027 年下半年，大幅提前至最快今年 12 月。
費羅里等人在最新給客戶的每週市場展望報告中說明相關疑慮。
費羅里認為，華許雖言詞強硬地宣示對抗通膨決心，卻未能提供具體的政策前瞻指引，且針對維持利率不變的決策交代不清；此外，華許對聯準會現行通膨核心指標——個人消費支出物價指數（PCE）表達了懷疑，也引發市場質疑。
華許當時表示，雖然 PCE 目前仍是聯準會的觀察重點，但他不確定明年 1 月後的策略會如何調整，並暗示將交由特別小組進行評估。
摩根大通經濟學家認為，若連聯準會主席本人都不確定指標走向，市場自然無所適從。
債券市場最擔心的是，這些工作小組可能缺乏足夠獨立性，最終只是替華許偏向緊縮的貨幣政策立場背書；此外，華許也可能透過調整聯準會通膨衡量基準，改變市場對通膨目標的認知。
債券市場已明確表達反應。摩根大通指出：「市場並不喜歡所聽到的內容，華許發言期間，殖利率曲線明顯趨陡，通膨損益平衡率也同步上升。」
費羅里預期，聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）的其他成員將感受到維護物價穩定目標的迫切壓力，因此他預測聯準會將在 12 月升息一碼（25 個基點），同時也承認「不排除 FOMC 在 9 月下次會議即採取行動的風險」。
即將於 8 月 12 日公布的 7 月消費者物價指數（CPI）報告，現已成為決定 9 月 15 日至 16 日 FOMC 會議是否採取行動的關鍵指標。
美銀經濟學家在另一份報告中也表達了相同憂慮，認為殖利率曲線陡峭、股市下跌及美元走軟的市場表現，極為貼近新興市場央行面臨公信力危機時的反應。
他們直言聯準會正陷入嚴重的信賴危機，除非後續數據轉向鴿派，否則聯準會為了重拾政策主導權，9 月升息將勢在必行。
儘管紐約聯儲銀行總裁威廉斯（John Williams）在週一接受路透社專訪時表示，現行貨幣政策位置合適，但也坦言央行仍需視核心通膨數據的表現，決定是否採取行動。
paras_en: JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) U.S. Economic Research team said that Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s performance at the press conference after last week’s rate decision was the most unsettling since the Fed began this style of communication in 2012, prompting the bank to move up its forecast for the timing of the next rate hike.

The research team, composed of Michael Feroli, Michael Hanson and Abiel Reinhart, noted that markets believe the Fed’s anti‑inflation credibility has been weakened, increasing the urgency for a policy shift toward tightening. Consequently, they have moved their estimate for the next hike from the second half of 2027 to as early as December of this year.
Feroli and colleagues explained the concern in their latest weekly market outlook to clients.

Feroli said that although Warsh spoke forcefully about the Fed’s resolve to fight inflation, he failed to provide concrete forward guidance and was vague about the decision to keep rates unchanged. Moreover, Warsh expressed doubt about the Fed’s core inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures price index (PCE) – which sparked market skepticism.
Warsh said that while PCE remains the Fed’s focus, he was unsure how policy would be adjusted after January next year and hinted that a special committee would evaluate it.
JPMorgan economists argue that if even the Fed chair is uncertain about the indicator’s trajectory, the market will be left without direction.

The bond market’s biggest worry is that these working groups may lack sufficient independence and could simply endorse Warsh’s tilt toward tighter policy; Warsh might also alter the Fed’s inflation measurement benchmark, changing market perception of the inflation target.
JPMorgan noted that the market reacted negatively to what was heard – yields steepened noticeably during Warsh’s remarks and the breakeven inflation rate rose in tandem.

Feroli expects that other members of the Federal Open Market Committee will feel pressure to protect the price‑stability goal, and he forecasts a 25‑basis‑point hike in December, while acknowledging the risk that the FOMC could act at its September meeting.
The July Consumer Price Index, to be released on August 12, has become the key gauge for deciding whether the FOMC will act at its September 15‑16 meeting.

Bank of America economists voiced the same concerns in a separate report, noting that the steepening yield curve, falling equity markets and a weaker dollar mirror the reactions seen in emerging‑market central banks facing credibility crises.
They warned that the Fed is in a serious trust crisis and, unless upcoming data turn dovish, a September rate hike will be inevitable for the Fed to regain policy leadership.

Even though New York Fed President John Williams told Reuters on Monday that the current policy stance is appropriate, he admitted the central bank still needs to watch core‑inflation data to decide whether to act.

items.title: 長鑫存儲擴產逼近！美光不跌反漲 市場在押什麼？
items.title_en: CXMT Expansion Imminent! Micron Bounces Back, Market Awaits What's Next?
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，中國記憶體大廠長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 傳出擴產計畫，全球 DRAM 市場競爭可望進一步升溫。不過，美光 (MU-US) 週一 (3 日) 股價未受消息明顯拖累，早盤一度跌逾 3% 後逆轉收高，市場短線仍將美光股價走弱視為資金輪動，而非產業基本面惡化。
美光週一盤初最多下跌 3.4%，觸及每股 795.02 美元，隨後逐步收復失地，終場上漲 0.79%，收在 829.50 美元，上漲 6.47 美元。費城半導體指數同日上漲逾 1%。Sandisk (SNDK-US) 猛漲超 6%。
美光股價回穩之際，中國競爭對手正準備擴大生產規模。
《路透》報導，長鑫存儲近期完成首次公開募股 (IPO) 後，正在評估於北京興建第二座記憶體晶片工廠，並可能把每月晶圓產能提高近一倍，增至逾 60 萬片。
長鑫存儲目前仍落後主要記憶體製造商，但市占率正快速提升。Counterpoint Research 數據顯示，該公司今年第一季占全球 DRAM 市場約 8%，高於去年同期的 3%，目前已是全球第四大 DRAM 製造商。
相較之下，美光同期市占率約為 22%，SK 海力士與三星電子的市場地位則更加穩固。儘管差距仍大，長鑫存儲可望利用 IPO 籌得的資金擴充產能，為未來爭取更多全球市占率奠定基礎。
長鑫存儲的擴張也牽動蘋果 (AAPL-US) 在中國的供應鏈布局。
《華爾街日報》報導，蘋果希望在中國銷售的裝置中使用長鑫存儲晶片，因此遊說川普政府不要將該公司列入美國貿易黑名單。蘋果與長鑫存儲均未立即回應置評請求。
另一方面，南韓記憶體類股週一明顯走弱。SK 海力士與三星電子在南韓市場均收跌 8.8%。
美股時段，SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 盤中一度下挫 4.4%，終場跌幅收斂至不到 1%。
瑞穗證券交易部分析師 Jordan Klein 指出，亞洲記憶體股本週開局表現不佳，但這種走勢更可能受到南韓股市部位平倉及資金輪動影響，而非產業基本面發生變化。他認為，市場目前仍在消化去槓桿與資金重新配置的壓力。
paras_en: According to a report by Barron's, China's memory chip giant CXMT (CXMT) is rumored to be expanding its production plans, which could further heat up the global DRAM market competition. However, Micron (MU-US) stock price did not seem to be significantly affected by the news on Monday, with its stock price reversing a 3% drop in the morning session to close higher. The market still views Micron's short-term weakness as a result of capital rotation rather than a deterioration in the industry's fundamental.

Micron's stock price dropped as much as 3.4% in the morning session, touching $795.02 per share, before recovering its losses and closing 0.79% higher at $829.50, up $6.47. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose over 1% on the same day. Sandisk (SNDK-US) surged over 6%.
As Micron's stock price stabilized, its Chinese competitor is preparing to expand its production capacity.

According to a report by Reuters, CXMT completed its initial public offering (IPO) recently and is evaluating the construction of a second memory chip factory in Beijing, which could increase its monthly wafer production capacity by nearly a factor of two to over 600,000 units.

CXMT still lags behind major memory manufacturers, but its market share is rapidly increasing. Counterpoint Research data shows that the company's market share in the global DRAM market was around 8% in the first quarter of this year, up from 3% in the same period last year, making it the world's fourth-largest DRAM manufacturer.

In comparison, Micron's market share in the same period was around 22%, while SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics have a more solid market position. Although the gap is still significant, CXMT is expected to use the funds raised from its IPO to expand its production capacity and lay the foundation for future global market share gains.
CXMT's expansion also has implications for Apple's (AAPL-US) supply chain layout in China.

According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, Apple hopes to use CXMT chips in devices sold in China, and has lobbied the Trump administration not to include the company on the US trade blacklist. Apple and CXMT have not responded to requests for comment.
On the other hand, South Korean memory-related stocks fell sharply on Monday. SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics both fell 8.8% in the South Korean market.
In the US market, SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell as much as 4.4% in the morning session before narrowing its losses to less than 1% at the close.

Jordan Klein, a part-time analyst at RBC Securities, believes that the poor performance of Asian memory stocks at the beginning of the week is more likely due to the impact of South Korean market position unwinding and capital rotation, rather than a change in the industry's fundamental. He thinks that the market is still digesting the pressure of de-leveraging and capital re-allocation.

items.title: 川普稱美伊正在談判 伊朗打臉：沒有任何會談安排
items.title_en: Trump Claims US-Iran Negotiations Underway, Iran Denies Any Talks
paras: 美國總統川普周一 (3 日) 表示，美國與伊朗目前正展開談判，並警告德黑蘭政府，現在是簽署協議、結束已持續五個月戰爭的「最後機會」。然而，伊朗政府隨即全面否認雙方正在談判或安排任何會談，凸顯美伊對外交進程說法南轅北轍，也顯示短期內透過外交途徑化解衝突的可能性依然有限。
川普在白宮橢圓形辦公室接受媒體提問時表示，美伊談判「正在進行中」，並稱相關接觸是在伊朗、沙烏地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合大公國及卡達等國要求下展開。
川普表示，「這是伊朗簽署一份好協議的最後機會。」他並未透露談判細節。
川普的說法，緊接著他上周末宣布取消原本授權的「大規模攻擊」伊朗計畫之後。當時他表示，由於即將舉行談判，因此決定暫停軍事行動，延續過去數月多次先宣布將升高軍事打擊、隨後又臨時撤回的模式。
不過，伊朗外交部發言人 Esmail Baghaei 稍早明確表示，目前沒有任何與美國進行中的談判，也沒有安排任何會議。未來幾天伊朗既不會接待外國代表團，也沒有派遣談判代表出訪海外的計畫。
Baghaei 指出，目前所有伊朗談判代表均留在國內，僅外交部長 Abbas Araqchi 因赴伊拉克進行宗教朝聖而暫時離境。他表示，目前唯一進行中的協商，是與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽管理事務所展開的討論。
一名伊朗高層消息人士也向路透表示，目前沒有任何美伊談判安排，而 Araqchi 至少在本周結束前都不會參與相關接觸。
分析人士認為，伊朗正試圖透過掌握中東航運路線、能源基礎設施及海上運輸等關鍵節點，提高美國及盟友介入衝突的成本，藉此迫使西方接受伊朗在荷姆茲海峽問題上的主張。
Michael Knights 表示，伊朗最大的優勢，在於有能力衝擊區域國家及全球經濟，這也是德黑蘭目前最重要的談判籌碼。
川普稍晚再度透過 Truth Social 發文，批評伊朗領導層「極度虛偽」，並宣稱是伊朗主動要求會面，雙方未來將於近期安排更多談判。
他同時重申，美國海軍已完全控制荷姆茲海峽。他表示，在達成協議或伊朗「全面投降」之前，「沒有任何東西能送進伊朗，除非我們允許；沒有任何東西能通過，除非達成協議或全面投降。」
自川普與以色列五個多月前共同發動代號「Operation Epic Fury」的軍事行動以來，美伊關係便持續陷入軍事升級與外交喊話交替循環。川普多次揚言擴大軍事打擊，之後又以外交接觸為由暫停行動。
然而，自 6 月美伊簽署旨在終結衝突的諒解備忘錄於 7 月初破局後，伊朗便持續公開拒絕與華府展開正式談判。
目前川普政府原先設定的三大目標，包括摧毀伊朗核計畫、削弱伊朗攻擊區域對手能力，以及促成伊朗神權政府垮台，至今仍未實現。
此外，美方歷次升高軍事壓力後，伊朗均以加強攻擊美軍、中東盟友及商船作為回應，使衝突持續升溫，而川普最終又多次選擇避免全面軍事升級。
荷姆茲海峽依然是雙方最主要爭議。華府主張，6 月簽署的諒解備忘錄要求伊朗重新開放這條全球最重要的能源運輸通道；但德黑蘭則認為，協議內容明確保留伊朗對海上交通管理的權限。
若伊朗維持對荷姆茲海峽的控制權，其在戰後的戰略地位將較戰前更具優勢，也可能被外界視為川普政府的重要外交挫敗。
截至目前，美國仍未能迫使伊朗放棄對荷姆茲海峽的控制，而該水道在衝突爆發前承擔全球約五分之一的原油及液化天然氣 (LNG) 運輸，也因此持續推升全球能源價格及美國國內汽油價格。
市場則對緊張局勢可能降溫抱持樂觀期待。受川普談及外交協商影響，國際油價周一大幅回落，布蘭特原油期貨重挫約 7%，收在每桶 83.77 美元；美股同步走強，道瓊工業指數則創下歷史收盤新高。
paras_en: US President Trump said on Monday that the US and Iran are currently engaged in negotiations, warning the Iranian government that this is the 'last chance' to sign an agreement and end the five-month war. However, the Iranian government immediately denied any talks or arrangements, highlighting the discrepancy in diplomatic statements from both sides and showing that a peaceful resolution through diplomacy in the short term is still unlikely.

Trump made the statement in the Oval Office during a press conference, saying that the US-Iran talks are 'ongoing' and that the contacts were initiated at the request of Iran, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar.
Trump said, 'This is the last chance for Iran to sign a good agreement.' He did not reveal any details of the negotiations.
Trump's statement came after he announced over the weekend that he was canceling the 'large-scale attack' on Iran plan, saying that he was putting it on hold due to the upcoming talks.

However, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei immediately denied any ongoing talks with the US, saying that there were no arrangements for any meetings or negotiations in the near future.
Baghaei said that all Iranian negotiators are currently in the country, with only Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi temporarily outside the country for a pilgrimage to Iraq.
A high-ranking Iranian official also told Reuters that there were no US-Iran talks scheduled, and that Araqchi would not participate in any such talks before the end of the week.

Analysts believe that Iran is trying to increase the cost of US and its allies' intervention in the conflict by controlling key nodes in the Middle East, such as shipping routes, energy infrastructure, and sea transportation.
Michael Knights said that Iran's greatest advantage is its ability to disrupt regional and global economies, which is also its most important bargaining chip in the current negotiations.

Trump later posted on Truth Social, criticizing the Iranian leadership for being 'extremely dishonest' and claiming that Iran had initiated the request for talks, with more negotiations to be scheduled in the near future.

He also reiterated that the US Navy has complete control over the Strait of Hormuz, saying that 'nothing goes in or out of Iran unless we allow it; nothing goes through unless we agree to it or Iran surrenders completely.'
Since Trump and Israel launched the 'Operation Epic Fury' military operation five months ago, the US-Iran relationship has been stuck in a cycle of military escalation and diplomatic rhetoric.
Trump has repeatedly threatened to expand military strikes, only to put them on hold due to diplomatic contacts.
However, since the June agreement to end the conflict broke down in July, Iran has consistently refused to engage in formal talks with Washington.

The three main goals set by the Trump administration, including destroying Iran's nuclear program, weakening Iran's ability to attack regional adversaries, and toppling the Iranian government, remain unachieved.
Each time the US has increased military pressure, Iran has responded by strengthening its attacks on US forces, regional allies, and commercial ships, keeping the conflict escalating.

The Strait of Hormuz remains the main point of contention between the two sides, with Washington insisting that the June agreement requires Iran to reopen the global energy transportation route, while Tehran claims that the agreement preserves its right to manage maritime traffic.

If Iran maintains control over the Strait of Hormuz, its strategic position will be stronger than before the conflict, and may be seen as a significant diplomatic failure for the Trump administration.

The US has not yet been able to persuade Iran to give up control over the Strait of Hormuz, which carried about a fifth of the world's oil and LNG before the conflict, and has continued to drive up global energy prices and US gasoline prices.

The market remains optimistic that the tensions will ease, with international oil prices falling sharply on Monday after Trump mentioned diplomatic talks, with Brent crude futures plummeting by about 7% to $83.77 per barrel, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average reaching a new historical high.

items.title: 日元急升近5%只是曇花一現？ 美日聯手救匯率仍難敵利差 市場看衰日元長線走勢
items.title_en: Yen's 5% Surge May Be Just a Fleeting Moment: Joint Intervention Fails to Overcome Interest Rate Gap
paras: 美國與日本近日聯手干預外匯市場，推動日元自 40 年低點大幅反彈，單週升值近 5%，但市場普遍認為，在美日利率差距依舊懸殊、日本央行尚未採取進一步緊縮政策下，此次規模空前的干預行動恐怕只能暫時穩定匯市，難以從根本扭轉日元長期弱勢。
根據先前報導，美國總統川普在內閣會議中證實，美方參與此次聯合干預行動，並形容此舉是「友誼的信號」。
日本財務省隨後正式確認，已與美國財政部共同進場干預匯市，使日元自上週觸及的 40 年低點、每美元兌 164 日元，回升至 156.8 日元，單週升值幅度接近 5%。市場估計，本次干預規模超過 500 億美元。
不過，市場對此次干預反應相對冷淡。儘管日元短線急升，但匯價僅回到今年 5 月附近水準，年初至今兌美元升幅幾乎歸零。相較之下，2024 年日本銀行單獨干預匯市時，曾成功將日元由 161 升至 141，累計升值約 12%，此次反彈力道明顯較弱。
多位外匯策略師及經濟學家指出，只要美日利差維持高檔，任何官方干預都只能延緩跌勢，而無法改變日元疲弱的基本面。
此次聯合干預也被視為美日歷來規模最大的協同行動之一。有媒體拍攝到美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 桌上的待辦事項，其中寫有「買入日元 50 至 100 億美元」。另據《金融時報》引述知情人士報導，紐約聯邦準備銀行此次透過出售歐元、買入日元的方式參與市場操作。
值得注意的是，日本過去進場干預時，多半透過出售持有、規模約 1.1 兆美元的美國公債籌措資金。然而，目前 30 年期美國公債殖利率接近 20 年高點，大規模出售美債可能進一步推升殖利率，因此也限制了日本的操作空間。
此次干預也帶來另一項市場效應，美元指數跌破 100，為今年 6 月以來首見。在正式干預之前，Scott Bessent 與日本財務大臣片山皋月皆曾透過公開喊話試圖提振日元，但效果有限，最終促使雙方採取實際市場干預。
市場人士普遍認為，真正左右日元走勢的仍是利率差距，而非短期官方進場買盤。
Robin Brooks 表示，日元疲弱並非源於投機資金刻意做空，而是日本公債殖利率遠低於合理水準。他指出，資金自然流向報酬率較高的市場，才是日元持續承壓的根本原因。
目前日本政策利率僅 1%，而美國聯邦準備理事會聯邦基金利率目標區間則維持在 3.50% 至 3.75%，兩國利率仍存在明顯差距。
日本銀行上週召開政策會議後，決定維持利率不變，進一步強化市場對利差短期難以縮小的預期。
荷蘭國際集團經濟學家 Chris Turner 指出，日本央行若能在 9 月 18 日政策會議展現更明確的緊縮立場，仍有機會升息 1 碼 (25 個基點)。但他也強調，目前日本消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2%，政策利率卻只有約 1%，仍低於通膨水準，顯示日本貨幣政策依舊相對寬鬆。
Gavekal 執行長 Louis Gave 也持相同看法。他表示，除非聯準會開始降息，或日本銀行啟動升息循環，否則日元難以出現具持續性的升值走勢。他並認為，日元與其他東北亞貨幣一樣，目前均處於「嚴重低估」狀態，相關觀點也與德意志銀行 (DB-US) 7 月發布的《世界地圖》研究報告，以及《經濟學人》最新一期巨無霸指數分析相互呼應。
從基本面來看，日本擁有七國集團 (G7) 中最大的經常帳順差，理論上有利於支撐本國貨幣。不過，過去 15 年間盛行的日元套利交易 (carry trade)，即投資人借入低利率日元，再投資高收益資產，持續削弱日元需求，使基本面優勢未能有效反映在匯率表現上。
分析人士認為，只要日本銀行未能在貨幣政策上採取更積極行動，美日此次聯手干預的效果恐將隨時間逐漸消退，在利差與套利交易持續存在的情況下，日元結構性的弱勢格局短期內仍難出現根本性改變。
paras_en: The US and Japan have recently joined forces to intervene in the foreign exchange market, driving the yen to a significant rebound from its 40-year low, with a weekly gain of nearly 5%. However, the market is generally skeptical that this unprecedented intervention will be able to fundamentally reverse the yen's long-term weakness.
According to previous reports, US President Trump confirmed that the US participated in the joint intervention, describing it as a 'signal of friendship'.

The Japanese Ministry of Finance has since officially confirmed that it has joined forces with the US Department of the Treasury to intervene in the market, causing the yen to rise from its 40-year low of 164 yen per dollar to 156.8 yen, with a weekly gain of nearly 5%. The market estimates that the intervention scale exceeded $500 billion.

However, the market's response to this intervention has been relatively lukewarm. Although the yen has surged in the short term, the exchange rate has only returned to the level of May this year, and the year-to-date appreciation against the dollar has almost returned to zero. In comparison, the Japanese central bank's single-handed intervention in 2024 successfully raised the yen from 161 to 141, with a cumulative appreciation of around 12%, this time the rebound is significantly weaker.

Several foreign exchange strategists and economists point out that as long as the US-Japan interest rate gap remains high, any official intervention will only delay the decline, but will not change the yen's fundamental weakness.

This joint intervention is also seen as one of the largest cooperative actions between the US and Japan in history. Media outlets have captured a to-do list on US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's desk, which includes 'buying 50-100 billion yen'. According to a report by the Financial Times, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York participated in the market operation by selling euros and buying yen.

It's worth noting that Japan has previously intervened in the market by selling its holdings of US Treasury bonds, worth around $1.1 trillion. However, with the 30-year US Treasury bond yield approaching its 20-year high, large-scale sales of US bonds could further push up yields, limiting Japan's operational space.

This intervention has also brought another market effect, with the US dollar index falling below 100, a first since June this year. Before the formal intervention, Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Nagata had both used public statements to try to boost the yen, but with limited effect, ultimately prompting the two sides to take actual market intervention.
Market participants generally believe that the true driver of the yen's trend is still the interest rate gap, rather than the short-term official buying pool.

Robin Brooks notes that the yen's weakness is not due to speculative funds deliberately shorting the currency, but rather that Japan's bond yields are far lower than their reasonable level. He points out that funds naturally flow to markets with higher returns, which is the fundamental reason why the yen continues to be under pressure.

Currently, Japan's policy interest rate is only 1%, while the Federal Reserve's target range for the federal funds rate is 3.50-3.75%, with a significant gap between the two countries' interest rates.
The Bank of Japan last week held a policy meeting and decided to keep interest rates unchanged, further strengthening market expectations that the interest rate gap will not narrow in the short term.

Chris Turner, an economist at the Dutch International Group, notes that if the Bank of Japan can show a more clear tightening stance at the September 18 policy meeting, there is still a chance to raise interest rates by 1 point (25 basis points). However, he also emphasizes that Japan's consumer price index (CPI) is already near 2%, while the policy interest rate is only around 1%, still below the inflation level, indicating that Japan's monetary policy is still relatively loose.

Gavekal CEO Louis Gave also holds the same view. He notes that unless the Federal Reserve begins to lower interest rates or the Bank of Japan starts an interest rate hike cycle, the yen will find it difficult to show a sustained appreciation trend. He also believes that the yen, like other East Asian currencies, is currently in a 'severe undervaluation' state, which is consistent with the Deutsche Bank (DB-US) July report on the 'World Map' and the latest issue of the Economist's giant index analysis.

From a fundamental perspective, Japan has the largest current account surplus among the G7 countries, which should theoretically support its currency. However, the carry trade that has prevailed for the past 15 years, where investors borrow low-interest yen to invest in high-yielding assets, has continuously weakened yen demand, preventing the fundamental advantage from being effectively reflected in the exchange rate.

Analysts believe that as long as the Bank of Japan does not take more aggressive action in monetary policy, the effect of the US-Japan joint intervention will gradually fade over time, and in the presence of the interest rate gap and carry trade, the yen's structural weakness will remain difficult to change fundamentally in the short term.

items.title: 誰說美股估值過高？研究揭本益比盲點：標普500長期報酬或「被低估」
items.title_en: Who says US stocks are overvalued? Research reveals hidden trend: S&P 500 long-term returns may be 'undervalued'
paras: 儘管當前美股本益比等估值指標普遍顯示市場已處於「高處不勝寒」的水位，但一份最新學術研究卻指出，投資人可能長期以來都誤讀了這些估值訊號。未來十年股市仍有望帶來不錯的報酬。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，這項研究由哈佛商學院學者 Sebastian Hillenbrand 與紐約大學史登商學院學者 Odhrain McCarthy 共同完成，題為《股市現金流中隱藏的趨勢》(The Hidden Trend in Stock-Market Cash Flows)。
該研究認為，投資人長期以來一直誤解了股票市場估值公式的解讀方式，包括本益比、循環調整本益比、股息殖利率，以及巴菲特指標等常見估值指標。
以標普 500 指數為例，目前本益比約為 25.2 倍，遠高於耶魯大學學者 Robert Shiller 統計自 1871 年以來 16.2 倍的長期平均值，甚至超越過去 150 多年來 92% 的歷史紀錄。
單看數字，確實令人擔憂市場評價過高。然而，兩位教授認為，這種分析方式具有誤導性。
他們的核心論點是，估值比率的波動其實受到兩種不同因素影響，但華爾街長期以來幾乎只關注其中之一，即市場在牛市與熊市之間循環擺盪的景氣週期。
從這個角度來看，本益比等估值比率愈高，代表市場估值愈昂貴，未來預期報酬率也就愈低。
然而，市場卻常常忽略了「企業獲利成長率的長期上升趨勢」這個因素。研究作者指出，估值比率提高，未必代表市場未來預期報酬率正在惡化；相反地，也可能代表市場預期企業未來幾年的獲利將以更快的速度成長。
研究指出，近 30 年標普 500 的平均本益比達 25.7 倍，幾乎是 19 世紀末 30 年間平均 14.7 倍的兩倍。
若進一步比對每股盈餘成長率的變化，差距更為驚人。近數十年來，標普 500 每股盈餘年化成長率約為 7.0%，相較之下 19 世紀末的年化成長率僅為 0.6%。
兩位學者因此認為，拿當今本益比與多世紀前的水準相比，根本是「拿蘋果和橘子比」。
然而，要區分目前較高的本益比究竟有多少來自估值提升，又有多少是因為企業獲利成長加快，並非易事。兩位教授則透過複雜的統計模型進行拆解。
Hillenbrand 表示，最重要的結論是，一旦將企業獲利成長加快的影響納入調整，估值比率對未來報酬的預測能力將大幅提升。
他指出，若未進行這項調整，多數最受歡迎的估值指標，在樣本外的預測表現，在統計上幾乎與擲硬幣沒有差別。
此外，將估值比率調整以反映企業獲利成長率長期加快的趨勢，還會提高市場未來報酬率的預測值。
為了說明這一點，Hillenbrand 分別計算了未經調整的本益比所推估的未來五年與十年報酬率。
若不進行調整，模型顯示股市未來幾年大致將呈現持平走勢；但在完成調整後，Hillenbrand 估計，未來五年的年化報酬率可達 7.0%，未來十年的年化報酬率則可達 7.7%。
雖然這些預估報酬率仍略低於股市約 10% 的長期年化平均報酬，但相較於許多傳統估值指標原本預測的負報酬，整體前景已明顯樂觀得多。
paras_en: Despite the current high valuation of US stocks, as indicated by metrics such as the price-to-earnings ratio, a recent academic study suggests that investors may have misinterpreted these signals for a long time. The stock market still has the potential to deliver good returns over the next decade.

According to a report by Bloomberg, the study was conducted by Harvard Business School's Sebastian Hillenbrand and New York University's Stern School of Business's Odhrain McCarthy, titled 'The Hidden Trend in Stock-Market Cash Flows'.

The researchers argue that investors have long misunderstood the way to interpret stock market valuation formulas, including the price-to-earnings ratio, cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio, dividend yield, and the Buffett indicator.

Using the S&P 500 index as an example, the current price-to-earnings ratio is approximately 25.2, far higher than the long-term average of 16.2, as calculated by Yale University's Robert Shiller since 1871, and even surpassing 92% of historical records over the past 150 years.
At first glance, the numbers do seem to suggest that the market is overvalued. However, the two professors argue that this analysis method is misleading.

Their core argument is that the fluctuations in valuation ratios are actually influenced by two different factors, but Wall Street has long focused on only one of them, namely the business cycle between bull and bear markets.
From this perspective, a higher price-to-earnings ratio means that the market is more expensive, and future expected returns are lower.

However, the market often overlooks the long-term upward trend in corporate earnings growth rates. The researchers point out that a higher valuation ratio does not necessarily mean that future expected returns are worsening; on the contrary, it may indicate that the market expects corporate earnings to grow at a faster rate over the next few years.
The study found that over the past 30 years, the average price-to-earnings ratio of the S&P 500 was 25.7, almost twice the average of 14.7 over the 30 years leading up to the 19th century.

If we compare the changes in earnings growth rates per share, the difference is even more striking. Over the past few decades, the S&P 500's annualized earnings growth rate has been around 7.0%, compared to 0.6% in the 19th century.
The two scholars therefore believe that comparing today's price-to-earnings ratio to that of centuries past is like comparing apples and oranges.

However, it is not easy to distinguish how much of the current high price-to-earnings ratio is due to increased valuation and how much is due to faster corporate earnings growth. The two professors used complex statistical models to decompose the effect.

Hillenbrand emphasized that the most important conclusion is that once the effect of faster corporate earnings growth is taken into account, the valuation ratio's ability to predict future returns is greatly improved.
He pointed out that if this adjustment is not made, most popular valuation metrics have almost no predictive power in out-of-sample tests, statistically equivalent to flipping a coin.
In addition, adjusting the valuation ratio to reflect the long-term upward trend in corporate earnings growth rates will also increase the predicted value of future returns.
To illustrate this point, Hillenbrand calculated the estimated future five-year and ten-year returns using the unadjusted price-to-earnings ratio.

Without adjustment, the model shows that the stock market will likely remain flat over the next few years. However, after adjusting for the effect of faster corporate earnings growth, Hillenbrand estimates that the annualized return over the next five years will be 7.0%, and over the next ten years will be 7.7%.

Although these estimated returns are still slightly lower than the stock market's approximately 10% long-term average annual return, the overall outlook is significantly more optimistic compared to many traditional valuation metrics that originally predicted negative returns.

items.title: AI需求熱！Palantir財報財測亮眼 盤後狂漲14%
items.title_en: Palantir's Financial Report Exceeds Expectations, Stock Price Surges 14% After-Hours
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US) 的業務持續蓬勃發展，儘管企業近期紛紛重新檢視 AI 預算，這家資料分析公司仍於周一 (3 日) 公布另一份創紀錄的季業績，營收大幅成長，獲利也優於預期，激勵盤後股價大漲超過 14%。
Palantir 第二季營收達 19.4 億美元，較去年同期成長 93%，優於分析師預估的 18.1 億美元。每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 0.41 美元，同樣高於市場預期的 0.34 美元。
Palantir 執行長 Alex Karp 表示，隨著市場興起「主權 AI」趨勢，加上公司持續與輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 合作，帶動客戶需求大幅增加。越來越多企業希望能夠完全掌控自己的 AI 模型與資料。
Karp 指出，目前許多企業導入 AI 的方式，是將公司「獨有的營運模式、核心競爭力」遷移到大型 AI 模型中，而這正是許多企業抱持疑慮的原因。
相較之下，Palantir 提供方案允許客戶在自己的基礎設施上部署、客製化並運行 AI 模型，同時完整保有資料所有權。
財報公布後，Palantir 股價在周一盤後交易大漲。不過，今年以來 Palantir 股價仍累計下跌約 25%，主要受到整體軟體股遭到拋售及估值修正影響。此前在 2025 年曾大漲超過 130%。
美國商業業務成最大成長引擎
Palantir 第二季的高速成長，主要來自美國市場，尤其是商業客戶業務。
公司第二季簽下的合約總價值達 33.7 億美元，較去年同期成長 49%。其中，美國商業客戶就占了 21.3 億美元。
美國市場營收年增 115% 至 15.7 億美元。其中，美國商業業務營收更大增 149%，達 7.64 億美元。
Palantir 財務長 David Glazer 表示，目前美國市場已占公司整體營收 81%，高於去年同期的 73%。
第二季調整後自由現金流達 12.2 億美元，也是 Palantir 首次單季突破 10 億美元。
Q3 與全年財測皆優於市場預期
展望第三季，Palantir 預估營收將介於 21.60 億至 21.64 億美元之間，明顯高於華爾街原先預估的 20.02 億美元。
由於美國商業業務持續強勁，公司同步將 2026 年全年營收預測上調近 5 億美元。目前預估全年營收將介於 81.50 億至 81.58 億美元。
近來 AI 產業針對許多議題展開激烈討論，Palantir 也公開表達自身立場。公司批評市場追逐所謂「tokenmaxxing」(過度追求 Token 使用量) 的風氣，並支持採用開放權重模型 (Open-weight Models)。
Karp 表示，「我們派駐客戶現場的工程師不是在賣 Token。」
Karp 也在致股東信中寫道，「我們目前的業績，只反映了公司軟體為客戶創造經濟價值的一部分。我們不是靠點擊數、Token 用量或聊天次數收費。我們認為，把現代經濟史上最重要的技術發展遊戲化 (gamification)，是搞錯了重點。」
paras_en: According to a report by MarketWatch, Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) has continued to thrive, despite companies re-examining their AI budgets. The data analytics company announced another record quarterly performance on Monday (3rd), with significant revenue growth and better-than-expected profits, driving its stock price up over 14% after-hours.

Palantir's second-quarter revenue reached $19.4 billion, up 93% from the same period last year, exceeding analysts' estimates of $18.1 billion. The company's earnings per share (EPS) were $0.41, also higher than the market's expected $0.34.

Palantir CEO Alex Karp stated that the rising trend of 'sovereign AI' and the company's ongoing partnership with Nvidia (NVDA-US) have led to a significant increase in customer demand. More and more companies want to have full control over their AI models and data.

Karp pointed out that many companies are currently introducing AI by migrating their unique business models and core competitiveness into large AI models, which is a cause for concern. In contrast, Palantir offers solutions that allow customers to deploy, customize, and run AI models on their own infrastructure while maintaining full data ownership.

After the financial report was released, Palantir's stock price surged in after-hours trading on Monday. However, the company's stock price has still fallen by about 25% so far this year, mainly due to the overall sell-off and valuation adjustment of software stocks. Previously, in 2025, the stock price had risen by over 130%.

The US commercial business has become the main growth engine for Palantir. The company's second-quarter revenue growth was mainly driven by the US market, particularly commercial customer business. The total value of contracts signed in the second quarter reached $33.7 billion, up 49% from the same period last year, with US commercial customers accounting for $21.3 billion.

US market revenue increased by 115% to $15.7 billion, with US commercial business revenue growing by 149% to $7.64 billion. Palantir CFO David Glazer stated that the US market now accounts for 81% of the company's total revenue, higher than the 73% in the same period last year. The company's adjusted free cash flow for the second quarter reached $12.2 billion, the first time it has exceeded $10 billion in a single quarter.

Looking ahead to the third quarter, Palantir expects revenue to be between $21.60 billion and $21.64 billion, significantly higher than Wall Street's original estimate of $20.02 billion. Due to the continued strength of the US commercial business, the company has also raised its full-year revenue forecast by nearly $500 million. The current estimate for full-year revenue is between $81.50 billion and $81.58 billion.

Recently, the AI industry has been actively discussing various issues, and Palantir has also publicly expressed its stance. The company has criticized the market's pursuit of 'tokenmaxxing' and supports the use of open-weight models. Karp stated, 'Our engineers on the customer's site are not selling tokens.'

Karp also wrote in a letter to shareholders, 'Our current performance only reflects part of the economic value created by our software for customers. We are not charging based on clicks, token usage, or chat frequency. We believe that gamifying one of the most important technological developments in modern economic history is missing the point.'

items.title: 記憶體超級週期掀漲價潮！今年Q2全球手機營收逆勢衝1090億美元 創歷年同期新高
items.title_en: Memory Super Cycle Triggers Price Surge: Global Smartphone Revenue Hits $109 Billion in Q2, Highest Ever
paras: 最新數據顯示，在記憶體漲價超級週期席捲下，全球智慧手機市場正出現罕見「量縮價漲、營收創高」的背離走勢。
市調機構 Counterpoint Research 周一 (3 日) 發布最新監測報告指出，2026 年第二季全球智慧手機業營收年增 7%，達到 1090 億美元，寫下歷年第二季最高紀錄，同期全球出貨量卻年減 11%，創 2013 年以來同期最低水平。
營收與出貨脫鉤的關鍵，在於平均售價 (ASP) 被硬生生墊高。
受消費者持續往高階機種遷移、以及 DRAM 與 NAND 成本暴漲迫使 Android 陣營普遍調漲終端價帶動，今年第二季全球手機 ASP 年增 17% 至 400 美元，同樣刷下第二季歷史高點。
Counterpoint 高級分析師 Shilpi Jain 表示，智慧手機市場已進入新階段，「出貨量不再是增長主要驅動力，價值增長成為核心槓桿」，而零組件成本上揚加速此一轉向。
隨著入門市場萎縮，多數 OEM 正棄守走量策略，把上漲的 BOM 成本轉嫁消費者，並借分期、以舊換新降低新興市場入手門檻。
品牌端呈劇烈分化。蘋果成最大贏家，今年 Q2 營收份額攀至 49% 歷史新高、營收年增 22%，出貨與 ASP 同步走高；在 Android 全線漲價時，蘋果僅對 Mac、iPad 調價，iPhone 維持穩價，反而放大相對性價比優勢，中國、歐洲與新興市場表現突出。
Counterpoint 研究總監 Tarun Pathak 提醒，蘋果未來數季仍可能跟進漲價。

Android 陣營則苦吞成本；小米 Q2 出貨年減 26%、營收滑落 17%，ASP 雖升 13% 仍補不上量價缺口，上週日更宣布小米 17 系列漲人民幣 400 至 500 元、REDMI K90 與 Turbo 5 全系列調漲 300 元，今年第三度調價；OPPO、vivo 營收分別年減 10%、11%，ASP 各漲 9%、13%，vivo 居前五大 ASP 增速之首，但價格敏感市場出貨流失抵銷部分提價收益。
漲價導火索一致指向記憶體。自 3 月 OPPO、vivo 先行調價，榮耀「煥新版」變相漲，三星 Galaxy S26 國行抬高門檻，各廠口徑一致：「不得已之舉」。
展望後市，業界普遍認為記憶體價格拐點未到，高檔有望延續至 2027 年，甚至是 2028 年。
《彭博資訊》記者 Mark Gurman 周一指出，蘋果「毫無疑問」將調漲 iPhone，受到記憶體與處理器短缺、iPhone 18 Pro 新相機系統與首款折疊 iPhone 昂貴結構所迫，常規機種估漲 100 至 200 美元，折疊款起跳至少 2000 美元。
Counterpoint 總結指出，供應端正取代需求端成為產業束縛，今年下半年全球智慧手機一出貨量恐再下探，ASP 仍具上修空間。當「薄利多銷」讓位給「高價值生存」，消費者要習慣的，是手機只會愈買愈貴。
paras_en: The latest data shows that the global smartphone market is experiencing a rare phenomenon of 'quantity contraction and revenue growth' during the memory price super cycle.

According to a report released by Counterpoint Research on Monday, the global smartphone industry's revenue grew 7% year-over-year in Q2 2026, reaching $109 billion, a new record high for the second quarter. Meanwhile, global shipments declined 11% year-over-year, the lowest level since 2013.
The key to this disconnect between revenue and shipments lies in the average selling price (ASP), which has been artificially inflated.

Driven by consumers' continuous migration to high-end models and the sharp increase in DRAM and NAND costs, Android vendors have widely raised their terminal prices, leading to a 17% year-over-year increase in global smartphone ASP to $400, a new record high for the second quarter.

Counterpoint senior analyst Shilpi Jain noted that the smartphone market has entered a new stage, where 'shipments are no longer the primary growth driver, and value growth has become the core lever.' The surge in component costs has accelerated this shift.

As the entry-level market shrinks, most OEMs have abandoned the volume strategy and passed on the increased BOM costs to consumers, while also using financing and trade-in options to lower the barriers to entry in emerging markets.

Brands have shown a sharp differentiation. Apple emerged as the biggest winner, with its Q2 revenue share reaching a new high of 49%, revenue growing 22%, and shipments and ASP moving in tandem. While Android vendors raised prices across the board, Apple only raised prices for Mac and iPad, while keeping iPhone prices stable, thereby amplifying its relative value proposition, particularly in China, Europe, and emerging markets.
Counterpoint research director Tarun Pathak warned that Apple may follow up with price hikes in the coming quarters.

The Android camp, on the other hand, is struggling with costs. Xiaomi's Q2 shipments declined 26%, revenue fell 17%, and ASP rose 13%, but still failed to make up for the gap. Last week, Xiaomi announced its 17 series price hike by 400-500 yuan, while the REDMI K90 and Turbo 5 series were raised by 300 yuan, marking its third price hike this year. OPPO and vivo saw revenue declines of 10% and 11%, respectively, with ASP increases of 9% and 13%. Vivo led the top five in ASP growth, but price-sensitive markets' shipment losses offset some of the price hike benefits.

The price hike trigger points to memory. Since March, OPPO and vivo have led the price hike, while Honor's 'new version' was effectively a price hike. Samsung Galaxy S26's domestic price hike has also set a precedent, with all manufacturers citing 'no choice but to do so.'
Looking ahead, the industry widely believes that the memory price inflection point has not yet arrived, and high-end models will continue to thrive until 2027 or even 2028.

Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman noted on Monday that Apple 'has no doubt' will raise iPhone prices, driven by memory and processor shortages, the expensive new camera system on the iPhone 18 Pro, and the high cost of the first foldable iPhone. Regular models are expected to rise by $100-$200, while the foldable model will start at $2,000.

8/4 台股盤前要聞

1. 台股 3 日在亞股中一枝獨秀，終場收在 43,386 點，上漲 266 點，站穩 10 日線，不過，外資期現貨同步做空，大幅加碼空單超過 7,000 口，淨空單口數超過 9 萬口，創歷史新高；現貨也調節二線晶圓代工廠與面板雙虎，包括聯電、力積電、群創與友達，四檔合計賣超張數達 15 萬張。

3. 台股 7 月如坐大怒神，歷經史上最大漲跌點洗禮後，投資人逢低買進態勢明確。統計最新台股 ETF 投資人數，市值雙雄元大台灣 50(0050-TW)、元大台灣 50 正 2(00631L-TW) 奪周增居冠、亞軍，0050 投資人數突破 350 萬，領先台積電來到近 50 萬，再創歷史新高。

paras_en: On August 4, the Taiwan stock market was the only one to stand out among Asian stocks, closing at 43,386 points, up 266 points, and stabilizing above the 10-day line. However, foreign investors simultaneously short-sold stocks and futures, significantly increasing their short positions by over 7,000 contracts, with a net short position of over 90,000 contracts, a new historical high. In the spot market, they also adjusted their positions in second-line semiconductor foundries and panel makers, including UMC, Powerchip, Globalfoundries, and AU Optronics, with a total of 150,000 shares sold.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWSE) held a press conference on August 3 to announce the revision of the 'Regulations for the Disclosure and Disposal of Securities'. To improve trading efficiency and maintain market order, starting from August 10, 2026, the 'suspension' period for disposing of stocks will be significantly shortened, and the matching frequency will be accelerated to every 2 minutes. Additionally, the TWSE will relax the standards for designating high-priced stocks and establish a semi-annual review mechanism.

In July, the Taiwan stock market experienced its largest ever fluctuation, but investors have been buying on dips. According to the latest statistics, the number of investors in the Taiwan 50 ETF (0050-TW) has surpassed 3.5 million, leading to a new historical high, with a lead of nearly 500,000 over TSMC.

The TWSE announced that starting from August 10, the suspension period for individual stocks will be shortened to 5 days (7 days for day traders), and the matching frequency will be changed to every 2 minutes. The market is concerned about whether the 'circuit breaker' mechanism will be introduced, similar to the US and Korean stock markets. The TWSE has stated that it will not consider this for the time being, as the Taiwan stock market already has a 10% fluctuation limit and instant price stabilization measures, which can provide a cooling effect and maintain market order.

The Labor Pension Fund has announced its impressive performance for the first half of the year, with a total fund size of NT$888.955 billion and a return of NT$202.024 billion, resulting in a cumulative return rate of 28.46%, a new historical high. Benefiting from the Taiwan stock market's rise above 46,000 and strong demand for AI technology, the average dividend per person for the new labor pension fund has reached NT$111,600, with all funds showing stable growth.

Memory module manufacturer Apacer (4967-TW) announced its second-quarter financial report, with a net profit of NT$2.412 billion, up 5.14% quarter-over-quarter and 21,827% year-over-year, and earnings per share of NT$26.47, a new historical high. The cumulative net profit for the first half of the year reached NT$5.344 billion.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Surge on First Trading Day of August, Dow Hits Record Closing High; Amazon Market Cap Breaks $3 Trillion
paras: 2026年08月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股8月首個交易日全面收高，道瓊工業指數創歷史收盤新高。市場預期美國與伊朗緊張局勢可望降溫，帶動油價與美國公債殖利率下滑，激勵投資人買盤回籠。
美國總統川普表示，美國與伊朗將就重新開放荷姆茲海峽展開談判，雖然伊朗否認將舉行會談，但市場仍期待衝突降溫。國際油價應聲重挫約5%，美國公債殖利率同步回落。不過，市場仍關注，若中東局勢再度升溫，恐再度推升通膨，增加聯準會升息壓力。
標普500指數11大類股中，通訊服務類股受Meta Platforms(META-US)與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)勁揚帶動，上漲逾4%，表現最佳；能源類股則因油價下跌而跌逾1%，表現最弱。
企業財報持續提供支持。根據統計，截至上週五，標普500已有304家公司公布財報，整體利潤年增率達29.3%，其中85.2%的企業每股盈餘優於市場預期。
亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)延續財報利多，市值首度突破3兆美元。本週市場焦點將轉向AI概念股財報，包括Palantir(PLTR-US)、超微(AMD-US)、SanDisk(SNDK-US)及威騰電子Western Digital(WDC-US)。
另外，必治妥施貴寶Bristol Myers Squibb(BMY-US)傳出與阿斯特捷利康AstraZeneca(AZN-US)進行初步合併協商，股價變動不大；萬豪國際Marriott International(MAR-US)則因第三季獲利展望低於預期而下跌。
紐約聯邦準備銀行總裁John Williams表示，對通膨壓力逐步降溫抱持樂觀態度。市場目前預估，聯準會9月至少升息25個基點的機率為66.5%，本週五公布的美國非農就業報告將是後續觀察重點。

paras_en: On August 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) — U.S. equities closed higher across the board on the first trading day of August, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average setting a new all‑time closing high. The market expects U.S.–Iran tensions to ease, prompting a roughly 5% drop in oil prices and a decline in U.S. Treasury yields, which encouraged investors to buy back into the market.

President Trump said the United States and Iran will negotiate to reopen the Hormuz Strait. Although Iran denied that talks would be held, the market remained hopeful that the conflict would cool. International oil prices fell about 5% and U.S. Treasury yields retreated in tandem. However, investors are still watching the situation; a renewed flare‑up in the Middle East could reignite inflation and increase pressure on the Fed to raise rates further.

Among the S&P 500’s 11 sector groups, Communication Services led gains, up more than 4% thanks to strong performances by Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), making it the best‑performing sector. Energy lagged, falling over 1% as oil prices slipped, making it the weakest sector.

Corporate earnings continued to provide support. According to data compiled up to last Friday, 304 S&P 500 companies had reported results, with an overall profit year‑over‑year growth of 29.3% and 85.2% of firms posting earnings per share above market expectations.

Amazon (AMZN‑US) extended its earnings‑driven rally, with its market value surpassing $3 trillion for the first time. This week’s focus will shift to AI‑related earnings, including Palantir (PLTR‑US), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD‑US), SanDisk (SNDK‑US) and Western Digital (WDC‑US).
At the close, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 704.52 points, or 1.34%, at 53,189.55; the S&P 500 rose 1.48% to 7,600.61; and the Nasdaq gained 2.12% to 25,912.86.

In other news, Bristol‑Myers Squibb (BMY‑US) was reported to be in preliminary merger talks with AstraZeneca (AZN‑US), with little movement in its share price, while Marriott International (MAR‑US) fell after its third‑quarter profit outlook missed expectations.

Federal Reserve Bank of New York President John Williams expressed optimism that inflation pressures are gradually easing. The market currently estimates a 66.5% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points in September, and Friday’s U.S. non‑farm payroll report will be a key focus for further assessment.

items.title: 佳必琪擬一年內加碼崧騰最多1成持股 每股價格上限60元
items.title_en: Chin Pao Ki to Increase Stake in Sungtop by up to 10% within a Year at a Price Cap of NT$60 per Share
paras: 連接線廠佳必琪 (6197-TW) 今 (3) 日公告，董事會決議擬自 2026 年 8 月 3 日至 2027 年 8 月 2 日止一年內自集中交易市場取得崧騰 (3484-TW) 不超過 10% 股權，每股價格 60 元內，交易總金額最高 4.23 億元。
佳必琪表示，此次取得股權目的為資產配置，增進資金運用效益，目前佳必琪持有崧騰 3381 張、約 4.289% 持股；旗下佳士麒投資則持有 1349 張、約 1.711% 持股；合計對崧騰持股 4730 張、持股比重 6%。
崧騰主要生產電控零組件產品，並擁有多款連接器、Busbar 產品線，已廣泛應用於電動車、儲能系統與伺服器機櫃等領域。
隨著雲端運算與 AI 應用快速擴展，資料中心對標準化與模組化平台的需求日益提升，OCP 架構成為全球基礎設施建置的重要趨勢，崧騰也持續推動產品與開放運算架構 (OCP, Open Compute Project) 的對接應用。
佳必琪近年積極衝刺 AI 電源布局，包括 ORV3 大電流電源線、Busflow 及 Busbar 等產品，均取得輝達 (NVDA-US) 及 OCP 雙重認證，並切入各大 CSP 與主要 ODM 供應鏈並量產出貨，成為下半年主要成長動能之一。
paras_en: Chin Pao Ki (6197-TW) announced on August 3 that its board of directors has decided to acquire up to a 10% stake in Sungtop (3484-TW) from the concentrated trading market between August 3, 2026, and August 2, 2027, with a price cap of NT$60 per share, and a total transaction amount of up to NT$423 million.

Chin Pao Ki stated that the purpose of this acquisition is for asset allocation and to enhance the efficiency of fund utilization. Currently, Chin Pao Ki holds 3,381 shares of Sungtop, approximately 4.289% of the company's shares, while its subsidiary, Chin Pao Ki Investment, holds 1,349 shares, approximately 1.711% of the company's shares. In total, Chin Pao Ki holds 4,730 shares of Sungtop, representing a 6% stake in the company.

Sungtop primarily produces electrical control component products and has multiple connector and Busbar product lines, which have been widely applied in the fields of electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and server cabinets.

As cloud computing and AI applications continue to expand rapidly, the demand for standardized and modular platforms in data centers is increasing. The OCP (Open Compute Project) architecture has become a major trend in global infrastructure construction, and Sungtop continues to promote the application of its products with OCP.

In recent years, Chin Pao Ki has been actively promoting its AI power layout, including ORV3 high-current power lines, Busflow, and Busbar products, all of which have obtained dual certification from NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and OCP. These products have entered the supply chains of major CSPs and ODMs and have been mass-produced and shipped, becoming one of the main growth drivers in the second half of the year.

items.title: 處置期縮短 首檔櫃買處置股適用新制將提前至8/10出關
items.title_en: Shortened Disposal Period: First OTC Stock to Benefit from New Regulations to be Released on 8/10
paras: 近期台股因波動劇烈，包括立委及市場高度關注，證交所、櫃買中心今 (3) 日下午分別緊急召開記者會，宣布修改含處置期間長短、撮合頻率等規則，新制於本 (8) 月 10 日起實施。櫃買今日也公告 1 檔處置股旭然 (4556-TW)，因處置期間屬新舊制交替期，原自明 (4) 日起處置至 8 月 17 日，現因新制而可在 8 月 10 日提前解除處置交易。
據證交所、櫃買公告，處置制度於 30 年以來首次變革，處置天數與撮合時間大幅鬆綁。其中，第一、第二次遭列處置的個股，其處置期間原為 10 個營業日，將縮短至 5 日，至於當沖占比較高的個股則為 7 日；撮合也從原定每 5 分鐘或 20 分鐘撮合一次，縮短為每 2 分鐘一次。
因市場新制將於 8 月 10 日上路，期間若仍處於處置期間股票，若於 8 月 10 日前已處置滿 5 日 (或當沖加重者滿 7 日)，則自 8 月 10 日起直接解除處置。
其中因櫃買中心今日公告新增處置股旭然，因最近 6 個交易日累積最後成交價跌幅達 40.8%，而遭列處置股。但因旭然處置期間剛好跨越新舊制交替，原訂舊制自 8 月 4 日起將處置至 8 月 17 日限制，因符合新制處置滿 5 個營業日規定，而提前於 8 月 10 日解除，成為首檔受惠於處置新制的個股。
依照公告，旭然明日處置仍為每 20 分鐘撮合一次，8 月 10 日的處置最終日將縮減為 2 分鐘撮合新制。
paras_en: Recently, the Taiwanese stock market has experienced significant fluctuations, drawing attention from lawmakers and the market. In response, the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market held emergency press conferences on the 3rd, announcing amendments to the disposal period and matching frequency rules, which will take effect on August 10. The GreTai Securities Market also announced that one stock, Hsuan Yuan (4556-TW), will be subject to the new regulations, and its disposal period, originally scheduled from August 4 to August 17, will be shortened to end on August 10.

According to the announcements from the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the GreTai Securities Market, the disposal system has undergone its first major change in 30 years, significantly relaxing the disposal period and matching time. For stocks that are listed for disposal for the first or second time, the disposal period will be shortened from 10 business days to 5 days, while stocks with high intraday trading ratios will have a disposal period of 7 days. The matching frequency will also be increased from every 5 or 20 minutes to every 2 minutes.

As the new regulations will take effect on August 10, stocks that are still under disposal during this period will be directly removed from disposal if they have already been disposed of for 5 days (or 7 days for stocks with high intraday trading ratios) before August 10. Hsuan Yuan, which was announced as a new disposal stock by the GreTai Securities Market today, has seen a cumulative decline of 40.8% in its closing price over the past 6 trading days and has been listed for disposal. However, as its disposal period coincides with the transition between the old and new regulations, it will be released from disposal on August 10, becoming the first stock to benefit from the new disposal regulations.

According to the announcement, Hsuan Yuan's disposal will still be matched every 20 minutes tomorrow, but on August 10, the final day of its disposal, it will be matched every 2 minutes under the new regulations.

items.title: 舊制勞退歡迎「變新」！專家提醒報稅撇步：純舊制自提享3大稅務優惠
items.title_en: Old System Labor Retirement Welcomes "Change"! Experts Remind Taxation Steps: Pure Old System Self-Payment Enjoy 3 Tax Preferences
paras: 勞基法舊制勞工退休金新規上路，今年 7 月 17 日修正生效的勞工退休金條例施行細則，正式允許純舊制勞工每月在 6% 範圍內自願提繳退休金至個人專戶，同時符合條件者也可與雇主合意提前結算舊制退休金並全數移入專戶，享有新制最低收益保障與免計入當年度薪資所得等三大稅務優惠，為退休資產累積提供更多元管道。
勞工退休金條例施行細則 7 月修正生效後，新增規定讓純舊制勞工也能透過自願提繳累積退休資產。KPMG 安侯建業稅務投資部執業會計師陳志愷表示，本次修正核心目的在於讓純舊制勞工也能自提退休金，並透過提前結算舊制並移入個人專戶增加儲蓄與投資收益來源。雇主不得拒絕勞工提出的自提申請，且勞雇雙方合意結算的舊制退休金必須全數移入個人專戶，不得選擇部分或不移入。

在稅務影響方面，陳志愷指出本次修正涉及 3 項重要課稅重點。首先，自提退休金免計入當年度薪資所得，依月提繳工資分級表辦理不計入課稅。其次，提前結算並移入專戶的舊制退休金，因勞工尚未實際領取，移入時不課稅，待未來請領時再依退職所得規定辦理。最後，實際請領退休金時應依退職所得計算稅負，當勞工年滿 60 歲或喪失工作能力符合條件時，無論自提金、結算移入金或累積收益，均應併入退職所得，超過定額免稅標準部分才須課徵所得稅。
陳志愷進一步說明，若勞工於提前結算後持續服務所累積的舊制退休金並未移入專戶，而是在勞動契約終止時另行給付，為避免重複適用免稅額度，應與先前已自專戶請領的退休金合併計算退職所得，再就超過定額免稅標準部分課徵所得稅。陳志愷也提醒，本次修正雖將自提機制擴及純舊制勞工，但並未改變其適用舊制的身分，雇主無須為其提繳新制退休金，仍應依結算後持續工作所累積的舊制年資提撥退休準備金並認列相關費用。
paras_en: The new regulations for labor retirement under the old system have taken effect. The revised "Regulations for the Implementation of Labor Retirement Pension" that came into effect on July 17 this year allow pure old system laborers to voluntarily pay 6% of their retirement pension into their personal accounts every month. Those who meet the conditions can also agree with their employers to settle their old system retirement pension in advance and transfer it to their personal accounts, enjoying three tax benefits, including the minimum guaranteed return under the new system and exemption from inclusion in the current year's salary income, providing more channels for accumulating retirement assets.

After the revision of the "Regulations for the Implementation of Labor Retirement Pension" in July, new regulations allow pure old system laborers to accumulate retirement assets through voluntary payments. Chen Zhi-kai, a certified public accountant at KPMG, stated that the core purpose of this revision is to allow pure old system laborers to pay their retirement pension themselves and increase their savings and investment income through advance settlement of the old system and transfer to personal accounts. Employers cannot refuse laborers' applications for self-payment, and the old system retirement pension settled by both parties must be transferred to the personal account in full and cannot be partially or not transferred.

Regarding tax implications, Chen Zhi-kai pointed out that this revision involves three important tax points. Firstly, self-paid retirement pension is exempt from inclusion in the current year's salary income and is handled according to the monthly payment table without taxation. Secondly, the old system retirement pension that is settled in advance and transferred to a personal account is not taxed at the time of transfer since the laborer has not actually received it, and taxation will be handled according to the regulations for retirement income when it is claimed in the future. Lastly, when the retirement pension is actually claimed, the tax burden should be calculated according to the retirement income regulations. When the laborer is 60 years old or loses their working ability and meets the conditions, regardless of whether it is self-paid, settled, and transferred, or accumulated income, it should be included in the retirement income, and only the part exceeding the standard tax exemption will be subject to income tax.

Chen Zhi-kai further explained that if a laborer's old system retirement pension accumulated after advance settlement is not transferred to a personal account but is paid separately when the labor contract is terminated, to avoid duplicate application of tax exemption, it should be combined with the previously claimed retirement pension from the personal account to calculate the retirement income, and then the part exceeding the standard tax exemption will be subject to income tax. Chen Zhi-kai also reminded that although this revision has expanded the self-payment mechanism to pure old system laborers, it does not change their status under the old system, and employers do not need to pay new system retirement pension for them. They should still pay the retirement preparation fund according to the accumulated old system seniority after settlement and recognize the related expenses.

items.title: 賴清德：「長照3.0」今年起將失能身心障礙者納入服務對象
items.title_en: Tsai Ing-wen: 'Long-term Care 3.0' to Include Disabled and Mentally Challenged Individuals as Service Targets Starting This Year
paras: 總統賴清德今 (3) 日接見首屆「金唐獎」得獎者及入圍者，除了肯定所有得獎者及入圍者打破社會刻板印象，努力追求理想，也感謝所有基金會及家屬的長期陪伴。賴清德提到，政府從 2024 年起推動為期 5 年的計畫，預計至 2028 年投入超過 480 億元，布建身心障礙照顧服務，今 (2026) 年上路的「長照 3.0」，也將失能身心障礙者納入服務對象。
「長照 3.0」是台灣因應超高齡社會升級的長照政策，其核心重點為擴大服務對象、放寬外籍看護家庭限制、以及導入智慧科技輔具。
賴清德致詞時表示，長期以來很關心唐氏症者的照顧和發展，很敬佩唐氏症基金會及所有支持唐寶寶的基金會夥伴、企業與愛心家庭，「金唐獎」的設立是表揚唐氏症者，消除社會的刻板印象，平等欣賞每個人的能力、努力和成就。
賴清德表示，未來政府會從三個方向，讓支持更完整：第一個是權利，政府會持續落實《身心障礙者權利公約》，讓政策從「替你決定」走向「支持你選擇」；第二個是照顧：政府從 2024 年開始推動為期 5 年計畫，減輕照顧者負擔，擴增社區與機構服務。第三個是健康：「健康台灣」會落實全齡照顧、醫療平權和身心障礙者的健康權。
賴清德提到，行政院最近也通過全面提高老農津貼、國民年金及六大社福津貼，其中包括低收入戶家庭生活補助、低收入戶就學生活補助、低收入戶兒童生活補助、中低收入戶老人生活津貼、身心障礙者生活補助及弱勢兒童及少年生活扶助等，政府未來將持續關注弱勢家庭的生活照料。
paras_en: President Tsai Ing-wen met with the winners and nominees of the first 'Golden Tang Award' today, affirming all winners and nominees for breaking social stereotypes and pursuing their ideals, while also thanking the foundations and families for their long-term accompaniment. Tsai Ing-wen mentioned that the government will launch a 5-year plan starting from 2024, with an expected investment of over NT$480 billion by 2028, to establish care services for people with disabilities. The 'Long-term Care 3.0' program, which will be implemented this year (2026), will also include disabled and mentally challenged individuals as service targets.

'Long-term Care 3.0' is Taiwan's long-term care policy in response to the upgrading of the super-aging society, with its core focus on expanding service targets, relaxing restrictions on foreign caregivers, and introducing intelligent technology aids.

In her speech, Tsai Ing-wen expressed her long-term concern for the care and development of people with Down syndrome, and her admiration for the Down Syndrome Foundation and all the partners, companies, and loving families that support them. The establishment of the 'Golden Tang Award' is to commend people with Down syndrome, eliminate social stereotypes, and appreciate everyone's abilities, efforts, and achievements equally.

Tsai Ing-wen stated that in the future, the government will provide more comprehensive support from three directions: first, rights - the government will continue to implement the 'Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities', allowing policies to shift from 'deciding for you' to 'supporting your choices'; second, care - the government will launch a 5-year plan starting from 2024 to reduce the burden on caregivers and expand community and institutional services; third, health - 'Healthy Taiwan' will implement age-friendly care, medical equality, and the right to health for people with disabilities.

Tsai Ing-wen also mentioned that the Executive Yuan has recently passed a plan to comprehensively increase subsidies for elderly farmers, national pensions, and six major social welfare subsidies, including living allowances for low-income households, living allowances for low-income students, living allowances for low-income children, living subsidies for middle- and low-income elderly, living subsidies for people with disabilities, and living assistance for disadvantaged children and adolescents. The government will continue to pay attention to the living care of disadvantaged families in the future.

items.title: 瑞儀2個交易日買回4436張庫藏股 每股均價84.35元
items.title_en: Ruiyi Repurchases 4,436 Treasury Shares Over Two Trading Days at an Average Price of NT$84.35 per Share
paras: 背光模組廠瑞儀 (6176-TW) 今 (3) 日公告，已斥資 3.74 億元，買回 4436 張庫藏股，平均每股買回價格 84.35 元，本次庫藏股進行僅 2 個交易日，執行率已達 44%。
瑞儀預定自 7 月 31 日至 9 月 30 日買回 1 萬張庫藏股，買回區間價格 65-100 元，股價低於區間價格下限，將繼續買回，預定買回股份占公司已發行股份總數之比率 2.87%，買回股份將轉讓予員工。
瑞儀上半年營收 231.24 億元，年減 6%，毛利率 21.91%，年增 0.25 個百分點，營業利益 28.57 億元，年增 24.6%，營業利益率 10.12%，年減 1.37 個百分點，稅後純益 12.92 億元，年減 28.6%，每股純益 2.81 元。
瑞儀說明，車載產品營收占比持續提升，AI PC 也加入成長動能，消費性電子因全球供應鏈產能受 AI、高效能運算伺服器 (HPC) 需求排擠，導致邏輯晶片與記憶體等關鍵零組件交期延宕且價格高漲，終端產品訂單波動影響整體出貨。
展望下半年，瑞儀認為，消費性電子產品展望穩健，預期背光模組需求不墜，營收貢獻有望與上半年持平；車載產品則展現出強勁的轉型動能，目前正處於新舊機種切換期，整體呈現「量縮價增」趨勢。
瑞儀目前為 Mercedes-Benz、BMW、和 Audi 三大歐系車廠車載顯示器主要背光模組供應商，並取得複數年供應合約，隨著歐系一線車廠新車款陸續推出，公司對全年車載產品的展望保持樂觀向上。
另外，瑞儀也看好 AI PC 為公司注入新成長動能，針對 AI PC 高效能運作下更為嚴苛的顯示器技術規格要求，瑞儀憑藉高亮度背光模組成功切入輝達 (NVIDIA)(NVDA-US)RTX Spark AI PC 供應鏈，可望進一步優化產品組合。
paras_en: Backlight module manufacturer Ruiyi (6176-TW) announced today (the 3rd) that it has spent NT$374 million to repurchase 4,436 treasury shares at an average price of NT$84.35 per share. The repurchase was completed in just two trading days, achieving a 44% execution rate.

Ruiyi plans to repurchase 10,000 treasury shares between July 31 and September 30, with a price range of NT$65‑100 per share. If the market price falls below the lower bound, the company will continue buying. The intended repurchase would represent 2.87% of the company’s total issued shares and the shares will be transferred to employees.

In the first half of the year, Ruiyi reported revenue of NT$23.124 billion, down 6% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 21.91%, up 0.25 percentage points. Operating profit was NT$2.857 billion, up 24.6% YoY, and the operating margin was 10.12%, down 1.37 percentage points. Net profit after tax was NT$1.292 billion, down 28.6% YoY, equating to earnings of NT$2.81 per share.

Ruiyi explained that the share of revenue from automotive products continues to rise, and AI PCs are adding to growth momentum. In consumer electronics, global supply‑chain capacity is being squeezed by demand for AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) servers, causing delays and price hikes for key components such as logic chips and memory, which in turn makes end‑product orders volatile and impacts overall shipments.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, Ruiyi believes the outlook for consumer electronics remains solid, expecting backlight‑module demand to stay stable and revenue contribution to match the first half. Automotive products, meanwhile, are showing strong transformation momentum; the segment is currently in a transition between old and new models and is exhibiting a "lower volume, higher price" trend.

Ruiyi is currently a primary backlight‑module supplier for automotive displays of the three major European car makers—Mercedes‑Benz, BMW, and Audi—and has secured multi‑year supply contracts. As these OEMs roll out new models, the company remains optimistic about its full‑year automotive product outlook.

In addition, Ruiyi is bullish on AI PCs as a new growth driver. To meet the stricter display‑technology specifications required by high‑performance AI PCs, Ruiyi’s high‑brightness backlight modules have successfully entered NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) RTX Spark AI PC supply chains, which should further enhance its product portfolio.

items.title: 台股7月跌6.5%消化風險溢價 聯博點出基本面具韌性關鍵原因
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Dropped 6.5% in July to Digest Risk Premium, UBS Finds Resilience in Fundamentals
paras: 台股歷經 7 月大幅修正後，聯博投信指出，本波回檔主要反映市場重新定價，基本面未見惡化，評價面已回落至合理水準，隨著長期成長動能仍在，投資價值已逐漸浮現，建議透過主動選股掌握震盪後的布局機會。
台股上週上演戲劇性反攻，週初指數一度受壓，隨後在權值股與低接買盤帶動下強勢反彈，單日創下史上最大收盤漲點紀錄，終場收在 43119.75 點，總計 7 月單月大跌 3006.16 點，跌幅達 6.5%。
聯博投信副總經理林炳魁表示，近期台股波動加劇，主因市場對人工智慧資本支出趨勢及貨幣政策走向存疑，導致情緒快速降溫，但這波修正反而使中期投資前景更具吸引力。
林炳魁分析，台股 7 月經歷兩次顯著回檔，與過去因經濟衰退引發的空頭市場不同，本次主要反映成長速度的重新定價，台灣經濟基本面依然穩健，全球對先進半導體、人工智慧基礎設施與高效能運算的需求持續擴張，科技龍頭企業獲利展望正向，核心動能未改。
此外，加權股價指數本益比已回到長期歷史平均水準，評價調整速度超越基本面變化，提供投資人以更具吸引力的價格布局優質企業的機會。
歷史經驗顯示，當市場因不確定性大幅修正且未伴隨經濟衰退時，後續 3 個月、6 個月及 12 個月的報酬表現通常較為正面。面對波動與產業分化，主動投資重要性提升，如 00404A 聯博台灣動能收益 50 主動式 ETF 透過主動選股，聚焦具競爭優勢的企業，並動態調整配置，核心仍以半導體等科技成長產業為主，並透過多元產業配置提升投資組合韌性。
paras_en: After experiencing a significant correction in July, UBS Asset Management pointed out that the recent rebound mainly reflects the market's re-pricing, with no deterioration in fundamentals. The valuation has returned to a reasonable level, and with long-term growth momentum still in place, investment value has gradually emerged, suggesting that investors should seize the opportunity to layout through active stock picking.

The Taiwan stock market staged a dramatic rebound last week, with the index initially under pressure at the beginning of the week, but then strongly rebounded driven by large-cap stocks and low-absorbing buying, setting a record for the largest single-day gain, closing at 43,119.75 points. The total decline in July was 3,006.16 points, a drop of 6.5%.

Lin Bingkui, Vice President of UBS Asset Management, stated that the recent fluctuations in the Taiwan stock market are mainly due to market doubts about the trend of artificial intelligence capital expenditures and monetary policy, leading to a rapid decline in sentiment. However, this correction has made the medium-term investment outlook more attractive.

Lin Bingkui analyzed that the Taiwan stock market experienced two significant corrections in July, which is different from the bear market caused by economic recession in the past. This time, it mainly reflects the re-pricing of growth rates. The fundamentals of Taiwan's economy remain stable, and the global demand for advanced semiconductors, artificial intelligence infrastructure, and high-performance computing continues to expand. The profit outlook for technology leading companies is positive, and the core momentum has not changed.

Additionally, the price-to-earnings ratio of the weighted stock price index has returned to its long-term historical average, with the valuation adjustment speed surpassing the change in fundamentals, providing investors with a more attractive price to layout high-quality companies.

Historical experience shows that when the market corrects significantly due to uncertainty without accompanying economic recession, the subsequent 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month returns are usually more positive. In the face of fluctuations and industry differentiation, the importance of active investment is enhanced. For example, the 00404A UBS Taiwan Dynamic 50 Active ETF, through active stock picking, focuses on companies with competitive advantages and dynamically adjusts its configuration, with a core focus on the semiconductor and other technology growth industries, and enhances the resilience of the investment portfolio through diversified industry configuration.

items.title: 亞馬遜市值站穩3兆美元躋身第5家 專家稱當前經濟縮影：完美融合消費與AI
items.title_en: Amazon’s Market Value Holds at $3 Trillion, Becomes Fifth Company; Experts Say It Mirrors the Current Economy: Perfect Fusion of Consumer Demand and AI
paras: 亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 市值周一 (3 日) 首度突破 3 兆美元，利多來自亮眼財報，以及人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮持續帶動旗下雲端事業需求增溫。這也代表亞馬遜成為蘋果 (AAPL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)、輝達(NVDA-US) 及 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)之後，第五家市值突破 3 兆美元的企業。
亞馬遜股價股價周一終場上漲 4.6% 至每股 284.02 美元，盤中一度大漲 5% 至 285.01 美元，改寫歷史新高，今年來累計漲幅已超過 23%。
亞馬遜上周公布財報後，股價創 2012 年 4 月以來最大單日漲幅，主因旗下雲端事業 AWS(Amazon Web Services) 營收年增 37% ，創逾四年來最快增速，公司也同步上調全年資本支出預估。
市場原本擔心超大規模雲端服務商 (hyperscaler) 可能放緩 AI 投資，但亞馬遜與微軟最新財報均顯示，AI 基礎設施需求依舊強勁，帶動市場情緒明顯改善。
Nationwide 首席市場策略師 Hackett 表示：「亞馬遜可說是當前經濟的最佳縮影，它同時代表消費需求，也代表 AI 發展。」
他表示，市場在財報季前最大的疑慮，是超大規模雲端服務商是否開始縮減 AI 投資，但從亞馬遜與微軟財報來看，並未出現這種情況，也讓市場更放心 AI 投資趨勢仍將持續。
在亞馬遜帶動下，其他大型科技股周一同步走高，微軟上漲 4%，Meta Platforms(META-US)勁揚 6%，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)上漲 3.6%，甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 漲 5%。
微軟上周表示，預估至 2027 會計年度仍可維持正現金流，且資本支出將低於華爾街預期，帶動股價創 2008 年來最大單日漲幅。
不過，各家 AI 投資帶來的財務壓力開始出現差異。特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 與 Alphabet 上季自由現金流均轉為負值，其中 Alphabet 更是首次出現負現金流，Meta 自由現金流則暴跌 91%，反映企業持續投入數十億美元擴建 AI 基礎設施。
Hackett 說：「市場開始區分『科技七巨頭 (Magnificent Seven)』誰是真正的贏家、誰是輸家。過去很長一段時間，投資人幾乎把它們視為同一家公司，但從上周開始，市場開始依照各家公司基本面分別評價，這反而是健康現象。」
目前曾站上市值 3 兆美元的企業包括蘋果 (Apple，AAPL-US)、微軟、Alphabet、輝達(NVDA-US) 與亞馬遜。其中輝達目前仍是全球市值最高企業，市值接近 5 兆美元。
亞馬遜在 1994 年由貝佐斯 (Jeff Bezos) 創立，自 2024 年 6 月市值首度突破 2 兆美元後，僅花約兩年時間便再增加 1 兆美元市值。
AWS 近年也積極擴大合作版圖，已與 OpenAI、Anthropic 及 Meta 等 AI 業者簽署雲端運算與 AI 晶片供應合作協議，持續受惠 AI 運算需求快速成長。
不過，若亞馬遜希望維持市場高度期待，未來仍須持續交出亮眼的雲端業績，尤其是在 AI 投資持續消耗現金的情況下。亞馬遜已將 2026 年資本支出預估由 2000 億美元提高至 2200 億美元，而過去 12 個月自由現金流仍為負 76 億美元。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) saw its market value break the $3 trillion mark for the first time on Monday (the 3rd), driven by a stellar earnings report and the ongoing AI boom that continues to heat up demand for its cloud business. This makes Amazon the fifth company, after Apple (AAPL-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US), to surpass a $3 trillion market cap.
Amazon’s stock closed up 4.6% on Monday at $284.02 per share, after spiking as high as $285.01 during the session – a new all‑time high – and is up more than 23% so far this year.

After Amazon released its earnings last week, the stock posted its biggest single‑day gain since April 2012, mainly because its cloud unit AWS (Amazon Web Services) posted revenue that grew 37% year‑over‑year, the fastest pace in over four years, and the company also raised its full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook.

The market had been worried that hyperscale cloud providers might start to scale back AI investment, but the latest earnings from Amazon and Microsoft both show that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong, lifting market sentiment noticeably.
Nationwide chief market strategist Hackett said, “Amazon can be seen as the best micro‑cosm of the current economy – it represents both consumer demand and AI development.”

He added that the biggest pre‑earnings‑season concern was whether hyperscale cloud providers were beginning to cut back AI spending, but the results from Amazon and Microsoft showed no such pullback, reassuring investors that AI investment trends will continue.
Following Amazon’s rally, other large‑cap tech stocks rose on Monday as well: Microsoft gained 4%, Meta Platforms (META‑US) surged 6%, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) climbed 3.6% and Oracle (ORCL‑US) jumped 5%.

Microsoft said last week that it expects to maintain positive cash flow through its fiscal 2027 year and that its capital spending will be below Wall Street expectations, driving its stock to its biggest single‑day rise since 2008.

However, the financial pressure from AI spending is beginning to diverge across companies. Tesla (TSLA‑US) and Alphabet both posted negative free cash flow last quarter, with Alphabet recording a negative cash flow for the first time, while Meta’s free cash flow plunged 91%, reflecting billions of dollars poured into expanding AI infrastructure.

Hackett noted, “The market is now distinguishing which of the ‘Magnificent Seven’ are true winners and which are laggards. For a long time investors treated them as a single entity, but since last week the market is evaluating each company on its own fundamentals, which is a healthy development.”

The companies that have previously reached a $3 trillion market cap include Apple (AAPL‑US), Microsoft, Alphabet, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and now Amazon. Nvidia remains the world’s most valuable company, with a market cap close to $5 trillion.
Amazon was founded by Jeff Bezos in 1994. After first breaking the $2 trillion threshold in June 2024, it added another $1 trillion in market value in roughly two years.

AWS has been aggressively expanding its partnership ecosystem in recent years, signing cloud‑computing and AI‑chip supply agreements with AI players such as OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, and continues to benefit from rapidly growing AI compute demand.

Nevertheless, if Amazon wants to keep market expectations high, it will need to keep delivering strong cloud results, especially as AI investment continues to burn cash. Amazon has raised its 2026 capital‑expenditure estimate from $200 billion to $220 billion, and its free cash flow over the past 12 months remained a negative $7.6 billion.

items.title: 長鑫存儲擴產逼近！美光不跌反漲 市場在押什麼？
items.title_en: CXMT Expansion Imminent! Micron Bounces Back, Market Awaits What's Next?
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，中國記憶體大廠長鑫存儲 (CXMT) 傳出擴產計畫，全球 DRAM 市場競爭可望進一步升溫。不過，美光 (MU-US) 週一 (3 日) 股價未受消息明顯拖累，早盤一度跌逾 3% 後逆轉收高，市場短線仍將美光股價走弱視為資金輪動，而非產業基本面惡化。
美光週一盤初最多下跌 3.4%，觸及每股 795.02 美元，隨後逐步收復失地，終場上漲 0.79%，收在 829.50 美元，上漲 6.47 美元。費城半導體指數同日上漲逾 1%。Sandisk (SNDK-US) 猛漲超 6%。
美光股價回穩之際，中國競爭對手正準備擴大生產規模。
《路透》報導，長鑫存儲近期完成首次公開募股 (IPO) 後，正在評估於北京興建第二座記憶體晶片工廠，並可能把每月晶圓產能提高近一倍，增至逾 60 萬片。
長鑫存儲目前仍落後主要記憶體製造商，但市占率正快速提升。Counterpoint Research 數據顯示，該公司今年第一季占全球 DRAM 市場約 8%，高於去年同期的 3%，目前已是全球第四大 DRAM 製造商。
相較之下，美光同期市占率約為 22%，SK 海力士與三星電子的市場地位則更加穩固。儘管差距仍大，長鑫存儲可望利用 IPO 籌得的資金擴充產能，為未來爭取更多全球市占率奠定基礎。
長鑫存儲的擴張也牽動蘋果 (AAPL-US) 在中國的供應鏈布局。
《華爾街日報》報導，蘋果希望在中國銷售的裝置中使用長鑫存儲晶片，因此遊說川普政府不要將該公司列入美國貿易黑名單。蘋果與長鑫存儲均未立即回應置評請求。
另一方面，南韓記憶體類股週一明顯走弱。SK 海力士與三星電子在南韓市場均收跌 8.8%。
美股時段，SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 盤中一度下挫 4.4%，終場跌幅收斂至不到 1%。
瑞穗證券交易部分析師 Jordan Klein 指出，亞洲記憶體股本週開局表現不佳，但這種走勢更可能受到南韓股市部位平倉及資金輪動影響，而非產業基本面發生變化。他認為，市場目前仍在消化去槓桿與資金重新配置的壓力。
paras_en: According to a report by Barron's, China's memory chip giant CXMT (CXMT) is rumored to be expanding its production plans, which could further heat up the global DRAM market competition. However, Micron (MU-US) stock price did not seem to be significantly affected by the news on Monday, with its stock price reversing a 3% drop in the morning session to close higher. The market still views Micron's short-term weakness as a result of capital rotation rather than a deterioration in the industry's fundamental.

Micron's stock price dropped as much as 3.4% in the morning session, touching $795.02 per share, before recovering its losses and closing 0.79% higher at $829.50, up $6.47. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose over 1% on the same day. Sandisk (SNDK-US) surged over 6%.
As Micron's stock price stabilized, its Chinese competitor is preparing to expand its production capacity.

According to a report by Reuters, CXMT completed its initial public offering (IPO) recently and is evaluating the construction of a second memory chip factory in Beijing, which could increase its monthly wafer production capacity by nearly a factor of two to over 600,000 units.

CXMT still lags behind major memory manufacturers, but its market share is rapidly increasing. Counterpoint Research data shows that the company's market share in the global DRAM market was around 8% in the first quarter of this year, up from 3% in the same period last year, making it the world's fourth-largest DRAM manufacturer.

In comparison, Micron's market share in the same period was around 22%, while SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics have a more solid market position. Although the gap is still significant, CXMT is expected to use the funds raised from its IPO to expand its production capacity and lay the foundation for future global market share gains.
CXMT's expansion also has implications for Apple's (AAPL-US) supply chain layout in China.

According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, Apple hopes to use CXMT chips in devices sold in China, and has lobbied the Trump administration not to include the company on the US trade blacklist. Apple and CXMT have not responded to requests for comment.
On the other hand, South Korean memory-related stocks fell sharply on Monday. SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics both fell 8.8% in the South Korean market.
In the US market, SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) fell as much as 4.4% in the morning session before narrowing its losses to less than 1% at the close.

Jordan Klein, a part-time analyst at RBC Securities, believes that the poor performance of Asian memory stocks at the beginning of the week is more likely due to the impact of South Korean market position unwinding and capital rotation, rather than a change in the industry's fundamental. He thinks that the market is still digesting the pressure of de-leveraging and capital re-allocation.

items.title: 誰說美股估值過高？研究揭本益比盲點：標普500長期報酬或「被低估」
items.title_en: Who says US stocks are overvalued? Research reveals hidden trend: S&P 500 long-term returns may be 'undervalued'
paras: 儘管當前美股本益比等估值指標普遍顯示市場已處於「高處不勝寒」的水位，但一份最新學術研究卻指出，投資人可能長期以來都誤讀了這些估值訊號。未來十年股市仍有望帶來不錯的報酬。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，這項研究由哈佛商學院學者 Sebastian Hillenbrand 與紐約大學史登商學院學者 Odhrain McCarthy 共同完成，題為《股市現金流中隱藏的趨勢》(The Hidden Trend in Stock-Market Cash Flows)。
該研究認為，投資人長期以來一直誤解了股票市場估值公式的解讀方式，包括本益比、循環調整本益比、股息殖利率，以及巴菲特指標等常見估值指標。
以標普 500 指數為例，目前本益比約為 25.2 倍，遠高於耶魯大學學者 Robert Shiller 統計自 1871 年以來 16.2 倍的長期平均值，甚至超越過去 150 多年來 92% 的歷史紀錄。
單看數字，確實令人擔憂市場評價過高。然而，兩位教授認為，這種分析方式具有誤導性。
他們的核心論點是，估值比率的波動其實受到兩種不同因素影響，但華爾街長期以來幾乎只關注其中之一，即市場在牛市與熊市之間循環擺盪的景氣週期。
從這個角度來看，本益比等估值比率愈高，代表市場估值愈昂貴，未來預期報酬率也就愈低。
然而，市場卻常常忽略了「企業獲利成長率的長期上升趨勢」這個因素。研究作者指出，估值比率提高，未必代表市場未來預期報酬率正在惡化；相反地，也可能代表市場預期企業未來幾年的獲利將以更快的速度成長。
研究指出，近 30 年標普 500 的平均本益比達 25.7 倍，幾乎是 19 世紀末 30 年間平均 14.7 倍的兩倍。
若進一步比對每股盈餘成長率的變化，差距更為驚人。近數十年來，標普 500 每股盈餘年化成長率約為 7.0%，相較之下 19 世紀末的年化成長率僅為 0.6%。
兩位學者因此認為，拿當今本益比與多世紀前的水準相比，根本是「拿蘋果和橘子比」。
然而，要區分目前較高的本益比究竟有多少來自估值提升，又有多少是因為企業獲利成長加快，並非易事。兩位教授則透過複雜的統計模型進行拆解。
Hillenbrand 表示，最重要的結論是，一旦將企業獲利成長加快的影響納入調整，估值比率對未來報酬的預測能力將大幅提升。
他指出，若未進行這項調整，多數最受歡迎的估值指標，在樣本外的預測表現，在統計上幾乎與擲硬幣沒有差別。
此外，將估值比率調整以反映企業獲利成長率長期加快的趨勢，還會提高市場未來報酬率的預測值。
為了說明這一點，Hillenbrand 分別計算了未經調整的本益比所推估的未來五年與十年報酬率。
若不進行調整，模型顯示股市未來幾年大致將呈現持平走勢；但在完成調整後，Hillenbrand 估計，未來五年的年化報酬率可達 7.0%，未來十年的年化報酬率則可達 7.7%。
雖然這些預估報酬率仍略低於股市約 10% 的長期年化平均報酬，但相較於許多傳統估值指標原本預測的負報酬，整體前景已明顯樂觀得多。
paras_en: Despite the current high valuation of US stocks, as indicated by metrics such as the price-to-earnings ratio, a recent academic study suggests that investors may have misinterpreted these signals for a long time. The stock market still has the potential to deliver good returns over the next decade.

According to a report by Bloomberg, the study was conducted by Harvard Business School's Sebastian Hillenbrand and New York University's Stern School of Business's Odhrain McCarthy, titled 'The Hidden Trend in Stock-Market Cash Flows'.

The researchers argue that investors have long misunderstood the way to interpret stock market valuation formulas, including the price-to-earnings ratio, cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio, dividend yield, and the Buffett indicator.

Using the S&P 500 index as an example, the current price-to-earnings ratio is approximately 25.2, far higher than the long-term average of 16.2, as calculated by Yale University's Robert Shiller since 1871, and even surpassing 92% of historical records over the past 150 years.
At first glance, the numbers do seem to suggest that the market is overvalued. However, the two professors argue that this analysis method is misleading.

Their core argument is that the fluctuations in valuation ratios are actually influenced by two different factors, but Wall Street has long focused on only one of them, namely the business cycle between bull and bear markets.
From this perspective, a higher price-to-earnings ratio means that the market is more expensive, and future expected returns are lower.
